title: Acquire an exact retained-memory hazard metric and an optimal experiment
statement: For the supplied absorbing-charge(p),nondestructive-read family in one retained-memory episode,sup over policies using<=H charges of complete-transcript TV between p<=q equals d_H(p,q)=max_(0<=k<=H)[(1-p)^k-(1-q)^k]. The block C^kR at a maximizing k attains it. Paid block counts give a positive predictor with this simultaneous all-policy confidence geometry;horizon order1/p requires Omega(p^-1 epsilon^-2 log(1/alpha)) charge calls even with a well-conditioned known state-setting core.

requires: Exactly the supplied one-parameter stationary absorbing family
One shared initial episode with retained memory across macros
Fixed calibration block h,or separately paid valid pilot/simultaneous/sequential selection
provides: Censored first-hit geometric variable is a common channel for every feedback transcript
Exact binomial interval for1-(1-p)^h transforms to a parameter confidence set;endpoint distances control every later policy
Unbounded one-episode horizon has diameter1 if compatible hazards include0 and positive p
Optimal distinguishing block and exact finite-H rational computation are explicit
assumptions: No generic CP topology inferred from rank2
Unlimited same-episode reuse is not unlimited fresh starts;new episodes need composition
Upper family theorem and lower bound are not N687 sampling claims
costs: N starts,Nh charges,N reads,including unsuccessful episodes;long preparation time paid
Known state-setting action adds no parameter information;does not erase1/p time scale
Float special-function diagnostics do not certify machine interval endpoints;exact binomial/rational arithmetic has its own bit cost
Matching charge order assumes supplied/paid scale hp between fixed constants,or variance-sensitive h=1 intervals
contract.units: Complete policy-law TV,charge horizon and acquisition calls
contract.obstruction: Resolved supplied-family calibration and information cost;no universal unknown-CP or conventional-HMM learning advantage.

evidence.range_scope: Supplied absorbing-charge/nondestructive-read family:exact policy-law distance,paid binomial confidence and time-scale lower bound.
Completed first-return Q52/Q17 family audit with independent Bellman and censored-hazard reconstructions;does not learn the topology.

body: Drawing a fresh geometric variable per macro would reset the memory incorrectly. Read calls and episode starts remain charged beyond the charge-horizon supremum.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
